titleEn: Minimum Number of Days to Make m Bouquets
title: 制作 M 束花所需的最少天数
summary: 第 bloomDay[i] 天第 i 朵花开放，每束需 k 朵相邻开放花，求制作 m 束的最早天数。
insight: 给定天数能否制作足够花束具有单调性。二分天数，线性扫描连续开放花数并每满 k 朵组成一束。
pitfalls: 同一朵花不能重复使用

solutions.title: 可行天数二分
solutions.idea: 在最小与最大开放日间寻找首个可行值。
steps: feasible(day) 扫描 bloomDay，开放则 consecutive++，满 k 后 bouquets++ 并清零；未开放清零
二分闭区间，feasible(mid) 收缩右界，否则左界右移

code.java: class Solution { private boolean feasible(int[] bloomDay,int m,int k,int day){int bouquets=0,consecutive=0;for(int bloom:bloomDay){if(bloom<=day){if(++consecutive==k){bouquets++;consecutive=0;}}else consecutive=0;}return bouquets>=m;}public int minDays(int[] bloomDay,int m,int k){if((long)m*k>bloomDay.length)return -1;int left=Arrays.stream(bloomDay).min().getAsInt(),right=Arrays.stream(bloomDay).max().getAsInt();while(left<right){int middle=left+(right-left)/2;if(feasible(bloomDay,m,k,middle))right=middle;else left=middle+1;}return left;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private fun feasible(bloomDay:IntArray,m:Int,k:Int,day:Int):Boolean{var bouquets=0;var consecutive=0;for(bloom in bloomDay){if(bloom<=day){consecutive++;if(consecutive==k){bouquets++;consecutive=0}}else consecutive=0};return bouquets>=m};fun minDays(bloomDay:IntArray,m:Int,k:Int):Int{if(m.toLong()*k>bloomDay.size)return -1;var left=bloomDay.minOrNull()!!;var right=bloomDay.maxOrNull()!!;while(left<right){val middle=left+(right-left)/2;if(feasible(bloomDay,m,k,middle))right=middle else left=middle+1};return left} }
code.cpp: class Solution { bool feasible(vector<int>& bloomDay,int m,int k,int day){int bouquets=0,consecutive=0;for(int bloom:bloomDay){if(bloom<=day){if(++consecutive==k){++bouquets;consecutive=0;}}else consecutive=0;}return bouquets>=m;}public:int minDays(vector<int>& bloomDay,int m,int k){if(1LL*m*k>(int)bloomDay.size())return -1;int left=*min_element(bloomDay.begin(),bloomDay.end()),right=*max_element(bloomDay.begin(),bloomDay.end());while(left<right){int middle=left+(right-left)/2;if(feasible(bloomDay,m,k,middle))right=middle;else left=middle+1;}return left;} };
